name: Worldview
description: NASA's satellite imagery of the whole Earth, every day since 2000, in a GIF. 74 layers from the Global Imagery Browse Services, a timeline you can scrub and animate, A/B compare, and an offline base map so the world is still there on a plane. One invite and someone else is looking at the same map, live.

at.label: Open looking at a place
at.detail: A place name, or coordinates like 51.5,-0.12.

date.label: Open on a particular day
date.detail: A day like 2018-09-12 — the imagery from that date.

layers.label: Open with these layers switched on
layers.detail: A comma-separated list of GIBS layer identifiers.

tour.label: Open one of the built-in scenes
tour.detail: Sets the place, the day and the layers for a scene like the Aral Sea or Hurricane Florence.
